sections.label: Book 31
sections.name: The Purushasukta, hymn of the Cosmic Person

verses.sa: सहस्रशीर्षा पुरुषः सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात्। स भूमिं सर्वत स्पृत्वाऽत्यतिष्ठद्दशाङ्गुलम्॥
verses.tr: sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt sa bhūmiṃ sarvata spṛtvā'tyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam
verses.en: Purusha hath a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Pervading earth on every side he fills a space ten fingers broad.

verses.sa: पुरुष एवेदं सर्वं यद्भूतं यच्च भाव्यम्। उतामृतत्वस्येशानो यदन्नेनातिरोहति॥
verses.tr: puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati
verses.en: Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall be; Lord, too, of immortality which waxes greater still by food.

verses.sa: एतावानस्य महिमातो ज्यायाँश्च पूरुषः। पादोऽस्य विश्वा भूतानि त्रिपादस्यामृतं दिवि॥
verses.tr: etāvānasya mahimāto jyāyāṃśca pūruṣaḥ pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi
verses.en: So mighty in his grandeur; yea, greater than this is Purusha. All creatures are one fourth of him, three fourths eternal life in heaven.

verses.sa: त्रिपादूर्ध्व उदैत्पुरुषः पादोऽस्येहाभवत् पुनः। ततो विष्वङ् व्यक्रामत्साशनानशने अभि॥
verses.tr: tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavat punaḥ tato viṣvaṅ vyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi
verses.en: With three fourths Purusha rose up: one fourth of him again was here. Thence he moved forth to every side over what eats not and what eats.

verses.sa: ततो विराडजायत विराजो अधि पूरुषः। स जातो अत्यरिच्यत पश्चाद्भूमिमथो पुरः॥
verses.tr: tato virāḍajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ
verses.en: From him Viraj was born; again Purusha from Viraj was born. When born, he spread to west and east beyond the boundaries of earth.

verses.sa: तस्माद्यज्ञात्सर्वहुतः सम्भृतं पृषदाज्यम्। पशूँस्ताँश्चक्रे वायव्यानारण्या ग्राम्याश्च ये॥
verses.tr: tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam paśūṃstāṃścakre vāyavyānāraṇyā grāmyāśca ye
verses.en: From that great General Sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up. He formed the creatures of the air and animals both wild and tame.

verses.sa: तस्माद्यज्ञात् सर्वहुत ऋचः सामानि जज्ञिरे। छन्दांसि जज्ञिरे तस्माद्यजुस्तस्मादजायत॥
verses.tr: tasmādyajñāt sarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata
verses.en: From that great General Sacrifice Richas and Sama hymns were born: Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.

verses.sa: तस्मादश्वा अजायन्त ये के चोभयादतः। गावो ह जज्ञिरे तस्मात्तस्माज्जाता अजावयः॥
verses.tr: tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ
verses.en: From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth: From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.

verses.sa: तं यज्ञं बर्हिषि प्रौक्षन् पुरुषं जातमग्रतः। तेन देवा अयजन्त साध्या ऋषयश्च ये॥
verses.tr: taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣan puruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye
verses.en: They balmed as victim on the grass Purusha born in earliest time. With him the Deities and all Sadhyas and Rishis sacrificed.

verses.sa: यत्पुरुषं व्यदधुः कतिधा व्यकल्पयन्। मुखं किमस्यासीत् किं बाहू किमूरू पादा उच्येते॥
verses.tr: yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan mukhaṃ kimasyāsīt kiṃ bāhū kimūrū pādā ucyete
verses.en: When they divided Purusha how many portions did they make? What was his mouth what were his arms what are the names of thighs and feet?

verses.sa: ब्राह्मणोऽस्य मुखमासीद्बाहू राजन्यः कृतः। ऊरू तदस्य यद्वैश्यः पद्भ्यां शूद्रो अजायत॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata
verses.en: The Brahman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Rajanya made. His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sudra was produced.

verses.sa: चन्द्रमा मनसो जातश्चक्षोः सूर्यो अजायत। श्रोत्राद्वायुश्च प्राणश्च मुखादग्निरजायत॥
verses.tr: candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata śrotrādvāyuśca prāṇaśca mukhādagnirajāyata
verses.en: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth; Vayu and Prana from his ear, and from his mouth was Agni born.

verses.sa: नाभ्या आसीदन्तरिक्षं शीर्ष्णो द्यौः समवर्तत। पद्भ्यां भूमिर्दिशः श्रोत्रात्तथा लोकाँ२ अकल्पयन्॥
verses.tr: nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokāṃ2 akalpayan
verses.en: Forth from his navel came mid-air, the sky was fashioned from his head; Earth from his feet, and from his ear the Quarters. Thus they formed the worlds.

verses.sa: यत्पुरुषेण हविषा देवा यज्ञमतन्वत। वसन्तोऽस्यासीदाज्यं ग्रीष्म इध्मः शरद्धविः॥
verses.tr: yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata vasanto'syāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ
verses.en: When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as offering Spring was the butter, Autumn the oblation, Summer was the wood.

verses.sa: सप्तास्यासन् परिधयस्त्रिः सप्त समिधः कृताः। देवा यद्यज्ञं तन्वाना अबध्नन् पुरुषं पशुम्॥
verses.tr: saptāsyāsan paridhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum
verses.en: Then seven were his enclosing-sticks, his kindling-brands were three times seven, When Gods, performing sacrifice, bound as their victim Purusha.

verses.sa: यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवास्तानि धर्माणि प्रथमान्यासन्। ते ह नाकं महिमानः सचन्त यत्र पूर्वे साध्याः सन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr: yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ
verses.en: Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim: these were the earliest holy ordinances. The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sadhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sa: अद्भ्यः सम्भृतः पृथिव्यै रसाच्च विश्वकर्मणः समवर्तताग्रे। तस्य त्वष्टा विदधद्रूपमेति तन्मर्त्यस्य देवत्वमाजानमग्रे॥
verses.tr: adbhyaḥ sambhṛtaḥ pṛthivyai rasācca viśvakarmaṇaḥ samavartatāgre tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhadrūpameti tanmartyasya devatvamājānamagre
verses.en: In the beginning he was formed, collected from waters, earth, and Visvakarman's essence. Fixing the form thereof Tvashtar proceedeth. This was at first the mortal's birth and godhead.

verses.sa: वेदाहमेतं पुरुषं महान्तमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्। तमेव विदित्वाति मृत्युमेति नान्यः पन्था विद्यतेऽयनाय॥
verses.tr: vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt tameva viditvāti mṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya
verses.en: I know this mighty Purusha whose colour is like the Sun, beyond the reach of darkness. He only who knows him leaves Death behind him. There is no path save this alone to travel.

verses.sa: प्रजापतिश्चरति गर्भे अन्तरजायमानो बहुधा वि जायते। तस्य योनिं परि पश्यन्ति धीरास्तस्मिन् ह तस्थुर्भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: prajāpatiścarati garbhe antarajāyamāno bahudhā vi jāyate tasya yoniṃ pari paśyanti dhīrāstasmin ha tasthurbhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: In the womb moves Prajapati: he, never becoming born, is born in sundry figures. The wise discern the womb from which he springeth. In him alone stand all existing creatures.

verses.sa: यो देवेभ्य आतपति यो देवानां पुरोहितः। पूर्वो यो देवेभ्यो जातो नमो रुचाय ब्राह्मये॥
verses.tr: yo devebhya ātapati yo devānāṃ purohitaḥ pūrvo yo devebhyo jāto namo rucāya brāhmaye
verses.en: He who gives light and heat to Gods, first, foremost Agent of the Gods, Born ere the Gods—to him the bright, the holy One, be reverence!

verses.sa: रुचं ब्राह्म्यं जनयन्तो देवा अग्रे तदब्रुवन्। यस्त्वैवं ब्राह्मणो विद्यात्तस्य देवा असन् वशे॥
verses.tr: rucaṃ brāhmyaṃ janayanto devā agre tadabruvan yastvaivaṃ brāhmaṇo vidyāttasya devā asan vaśe
verses.en: Thus spake the Gods at first, as they begat the bright and holy One: The Brahman who may know thee thus shall have the Gods in his control.

verses.sa: श्रीश्च ते लक्ष्मीश्च पत्न्यावहोरात्रे पार्श्वे नक्षत्राणि रूपमश्विनौ व्यात्तम्। इष्णन्निषाणामुं म इषाण सर्वलोकं म इषाण॥
verses.tr: śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśve nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyāttam iṣṇanniṣāṇāmuṃ ma iṣāṇa sarvalokaṃ ma iṣāṇa
verses.en: Beauty and Fortune are thy wives: each side of thee are Day and Night. The constellations are thy form: the Asvins are thine open jaws. Wishing, wish yonder world for me, wish that the Universe be mine.
